mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level, indicative of accommodative monetary policy, compresses discount rates for equity valuation and stimulates risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points in a single month signals accelerating labor market recovery, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE declines by more than 0.5pp in a month, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales signal robust consumer demand and economic momentum, which elevates corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise in the current month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both rise in the same month, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines in the current month
failure_condition: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), when FEDFUNDS declines, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and quarterly GDP growth signal comprehensive economic expansion, which elevates corporate earnings outlook and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both rise in the latest available period
failure_condition: When HOUST and GDPC1 both rise, the S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting anticipated monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0%, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
